speed.title: Make builds faster
speed.saved: Cache saved about {{saved}} across {{count}} builds (cold build {{cold}}, cached build {{warm}}).
speed.loadError: Could not load build speed suggestions.

cache_disabled.title: The remote build cache is turned off
cache_disabled.body: A cache destination is configured but disabled, so every build starts from scratch.

cache_unconfigured.title: No remote build cache is configured
cache_unconfigured.body: Most build steps run again each time. Pick a storage destination so steps are reused across builds and nodes.

low_cache_hit.title: Few build steps are reused
low_cache_hit.body: Put rarely changing steps first in the Dockerfile (copy the lockfile and install dependencies before copying the source), and add a .dockerignore for node_modules, .git and build output so unrelated files do not invalidate layers.

slower_recently.title: Builds got slower recently
slower_recently.body: The recent median build is at least 30% slower than the earlier one. Compare the latest deploys for new dependencies, a larger build context or a cache that stopped hitting.

settings.title: Build performance
settings.description: Cap how long a build may run and how many builds run at once. Extra builds wait in a queue.
settings.timeoutHelp: A build running longer than this is stopped and marked as timed out. 0 means no limit.
settings.concurrentHelp: Builds past this number wait for a free slot. 0 means no limit.
settings.defaultsNote: Defaults come from APP_BUILD_TIMEOUT and APP_BUILD_MAX_CONCURRENT: {{timeout}} minutes and {{concurrent}} builds.
settings.resetDone: Build limits reset to the defaults.
settings.rootOnly: Only a root account can change build limits.
